# What runs when an event fires

Follow `handled_by` and `dispatches` from one event down to the last handler.

<!-- generated:recipe:event-chain -->
<!-- Generated by `just docs-generate`; edit the source, not this block. -->

```php
use Lucasp\Loom\Index\IndexLoader;

$index = (new IndexLoader)->fromFile('storage/loom/index.json');

$follow = function (string $event, string $indent = '', array $path = []) use (&$follow, $index): void {
    if (in_array($event, $path, true)) {
        echo "{$indent}(cycle)\n";

        return;
    }

    // Listener classes, then closures registered for the event.
    $handlers = collect($index->handlersOf($event))
        ->mapWithKeys(fn ($handler) => [
            "{$handler->listener}::{$handler->method}" => $index->findListener($handler->listener)?->dispatches ?? [],
        ])
        ->merge(collect($index->closureListeners())->where('event', $event)->mapWithKeys(fn ($closure) => [
            "closure at {$closure->file}:{$closure->line}" => $closure->dispatches,
        ]));

    foreach ($handlers as $handler => $dispatches) {
        echo "{$indent}{$handler}\n";
        foreach ($dispatches as $dispatch) {
            echo "{$indent}  → {$dispatch->kind->value} {$dispatch->target}\n";
            $follow($dispatch->target, "{$indent}    ", [...$path, $event]);
        }
    }
};

$follow('App\Events\OrderPlaced');
```

```text title="Output"
App\Listeners\SendReceipt::handle
  → event App\Events\ReceiptSent
    App\Listeners\ArchiveReceipt::handle
    closure at app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php:14
      → event App\Events\ReceiptLogged
        App\Listeners\WriteAuditLog::handle
  → job App\Jobs\SendMail
  → mailable App\Mail\OrderReceipt
```
<!-- /generated:recipe:event-chain -->

A listener's `dispatches` covers its whole class. The `events-following` [MCP tool](../reference/mcp-tools.md) returns the same chain as JSON, with a depth limit. Loading the index is covered in the [PHP API](../reference/php-api.md).
